label: builder
definition: The agent that implements one issue in its own worktree from a brief: it commits, pushes, opens the PR and reports the PR URL, a short summary and the risks. It never merges. cckit orchestrate launches one builder per pane; a Task subagent with worktree isolation is one too.
is_not: The captain: the captain merges and advances the wave; the builder stops at the PR.
A reviewer: a reviewer reads the PR; a builder writes it.
A profile: an agent profile is the CLI, tier and args a builder runs with.
